body.title: Menu Panel
body.about: The framed background panel behind the game menu and its settings, load and save dialogs.

menu_save.title: Save Game Button
menu_save.about: Button on the game menu dialog (key S) that opens the save dialog.

menu_load.title: Load Game Button
menu_load.about: Button on the game menu dialog (key L) that opens the load dialog.

menu_new.title: New Game Button
menu_new.about: Button on the game menu dialog (key N) that starts a new game.

menu_quit.title: Quit Game Button
menu_quit.about: Button on the game menu dialog (key Q) that quits the game.

menu_settings.title: Settings Button
menu_settings.about: Button on the game menu dialog (key O) that opens the settings dialog.

menu_return.title: Return Button
menu_return.about: Button on the game menu dialog (key Esc) that closes it and returns to the game.

volume_panel.title: Volume Panel
volume_panel.about: The bordered panel around the music and sound sliders; shown only in the settings dialog.

music_label.title: Music Label
music_label.about: The word labelling the music volume slider; shown only in the settings dialog.

music_bar.title: Music Slider
music_bar.about: The music volume slider in the settings dialog; click or drag to set the level.

sound_bar.title: Sound Slider
sound_bar.about: The sound effects volume slider in the settings dialog; click or drag to set the level.

sound_label.title: Sound Label
sound_label.about: The word labelling the sound volume slider; shown only in the settings dialog.

settings_title.title: Settings Title
settings_title.about: The heading of the settings dialog; shown only while settings are open.

settings_rows.title: Settings Rows
settings_rows.about: The list of the engine's setting rows with their checkboxes; shown only in the settings dialog.

orionlayer_open.title: OrionLayer Settings Button
orionlayer_open.about: The button opening OrionLayer's own settings window; shown only in the settings dialog.

settings_accept.title: Settings Accept Button
settings_accept.about: The button that accepts and closes the settings dialog; shown only in that dialog.

slot_list.title: Save Slot List
slot_list.about: The list of save slots with their details; shown only in the load and save dialogs.

load_load.title: Load Button
load_load.about: The button that loads the chosen slot; shown only in the load dialog.

load_cancel.title: Load Cancel Button
load_cancel.about: The button that cancels the load dialog; shown only in that dialog.

save_save.title: Save Button
save_save.about: The button that saves into the chosen slot; shown only in the save dialog.

save_cancel.title: Save Cancel Button
save_cancel.about: The button that cancels the save dialog; shown only in that dialog.

help_popup.title: Help Panel
help_popup.about: The panel showing right-click help text; shown only while help is visible.
